title: P1 obs.append: request
description: Since v0.2: a job worker with an attempt token appends a point to a declared observation series from the observes of its task type; the model writes no points. The core sets the time, the tenant and the producer. Denials: fenced, type_not_allowed. The lease token is not passed in the body: the holder sends it in the Botaru-Lease header (spec/bindings/http/README.md), one way for all operations under a lease (FEN-2).
